[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Benkin''' was the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotide]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Benkin was old and bordering on senility. He met a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents who were posing as [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] to [[Mission to Lotide|infiltrate]] the Technical Branch Outpost.
